name: Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Rishi moon)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Rishi moon)/Legends
description: During the Battle of the Rishi moon, this OOM command battle droid, under the command of General Grievous, was dispatched to the Rishi moon to support the BX-series droid commandos. He was destroyed by Hevy
